title: Recipe app with smart shopping list
summary: Save recipes and turn them into a smart grocery list.
whyTempting: Saving recipes is universal; shopping lists are tedious.
whyItFails: Recipes are free. Content is abundant and commoditised. Retailers own checkout. Supermarket apps capture the transaction. Easily copied. Features are simple to replicate.
whatWouldChange: Direct checkout integrations with supermarkets earning referral revenue.

attempts.outcome: Acquired by Whirlpool, then shut down
attempts.notes: Recipe recommendations and search; team laid off in 2024 and the app went offline that December.

reasons.detail: Recipes are free: Content is abundant and commoditised.
Retailers own checkout: Supermarket apps capture the transaction.
Easily copied: Features are simple to replicate.
